definitions.full: H6316. Put מּוּט proper name, of a people probably Libyans , or Libyan tribe; usually named with African peoples: Nahum 3:9 ; Jer 46:9 ; Ezek 27:10 ; 30:5 ; 38:5 ( ᵐ5 usually Λίβυες ); Gen 10:6 (P) = 1Chr 1:8 ( Φουδ ); + Isa 66:19 (for מּוּל ᵑ0 ; ᵐ5 φουδ ), — see Di Gen 10:6 Jen ZA x. 325 ff .
